findings.title: Unparenthesized OR can be combined into broken AND logic
findings.body: The eventTypeId condition is an unwrapped `(a) OR (b)`. `getBaseConditions` wraps both parts as `(${auth}) AND (${filter})`, so that path is safe. But `getFilterConditions` output is meant to be reused, and in the reducer the first element is returned bare. If a caller interpolates it without parentheses next to other AND terms, precedence silently breaks the filter and widens results. The same applies to auth conditions: org/team conditions are bare `A OR B`, and user scope is `A AND B`. Wrap each returned condition in parentheses.

findings.title: Org-scope user condition skipped when org has no child teams
findings.body: `userIdsFromOrg` is `[]` when `teamsFromOrg.length` is 0, so only the team-booking condition is produced. Personal bookings (isTeamBooking=false) of the org's own members are therefore excluded. This is pre-existing behavior, but it is now an observable authorization gap. In addition, the team scope now omits the user condition when the team has no members, whereas the old code always included it. That is harmless but is a behavior change that is untested.

findings.title: Removed caching tests and the only end-to-end query test is narrow
findings.body: The caching tests were deleted without replacement, although the service still caches auth and filter conditions. The only DB-executed test is the user scope with an eventType filter. The org and team ANY(array) SQL is never run against Postgres, only compared as Sql objects, so syntax or type errors (for example ANY with an int array parameter) would go undetected. The BookingTimeStatusDenormalized view is also queried right after inserts, with no check that the view is populated.

findings.title: Removed findMany public method breaks callers
findings.body: `findMany` was removed and replaced by `getBaseConditions`. Any existing consumer of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` would break. The PR does not show that the callers were updated or searched for. The constructor option type was also changed to a new public type.
